ns2:section.sectionText: This seminar course will provide instruction, peer review, and practice for those online master’s students planning to complete their final poster presentation examination during the current semester. The course will also provide final instruction on exiting the program successfully. **Please note, you must have completed at least 31 hours of coursework, with at least 11 hours at the 500 level.**
